'''Volume 5''' is the fifth volume published by [[VIZ Media]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of [[Shogakukan]]'s collected releases of the magazine version.

==Blurb==
''The Gym challenges continue as Henry’s battle against Allister of Stow-on-Side rages on! Next, both Henry and Casey must prepare for a match against another powerful Gym Leader!''

''Will Henry and Casey ultimately be victorious against Opal of Ballonlea?!''
